articles.summary: MONDOVI, Wis., September 30, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) closed on the previously announced agreement to sell assets related to its intermodal business to Hub Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HUBG), effective September 30, 2025. The transaction was structured as an asset sale of certain intermodal equipment, including over 1,200 refrigerated containers, and contracts…
articles.title: MARTEN TRANSPORT, LTD. CLOSED ON THE PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED AGREEMENT TO SELL ASSETS RELATED TO ITS INTERMODAL BUSINESS TO HUB GROUP, INC., EFFECTIVE SEPTEMBER 30, 2025.
